title: Chapter 266
text:
"You've been losing blood all year round, causing your body to be weak, stunted, and organ functions to deteriorate. Optimistically, you can live for another three years …"

In the potion lab, Yi Yeqing was wearing a pair of rimless glasses as a doctor. She checked Aurora's body and came up with such a pessimistic result.

Without waiting for their expressions to change, she immediately changed her words. "Of course, I'm talking about normal people. Although your body is weak, your cell activity is something I've never seen before …"

As she spoke, Yi Yeqing took out a few photos under the microscope and said excitedly, "Normally, the self-healing of the human body is very slow. The intact cells slowly divide into new cells to repair the damage. In comparison, the self-healing ability of Supers is stronger. They can heal by converting energy or absorbing other energy. For example, I can absorb the life energy of plants to heal my injuries. Regardless of whether it's a normal person or a Super, self-healing requires energy and nutrients.

"And your cells are equivalent to a drop of extremely concentrated life energy, which can strengthen the self-healing ability of others hundreds of times. Your hair, blood, and all the other body tissues are equivalent to extremely powerful healing agents. How strong are your cells? Let me give you an example. A normal person's cell is a bowl of cold water, a normal Super's cell is a flame, and your cell is a star. There's no comparison!"

"Your cells actually have signs of self-reaction. Each cell is like a condensed star in its prime. Its activity is automatically increasing at every moment. However, such terrifying activity is not corrosive at all. It only has a beneficial effect on life forms. It is simply inconceivable …" Emerald Grass's heart was itching unbearably. Her eyes lit up as she stared at Aurora.

The burning gaze made Aurora shrink closer to Hella.

She recognized this gaze. All the white coats of the Germinal Organization looked at her like this.

"I want to collect some of your blood as an experiment material. Do you know …"

"No!" Hella rejected decisively. Her eyes were not friendly, and she was ready to attack at any time.

Aurora was her reverse scale. She would not allow anyone to violate it.

Han Xiao crossed his arms in front of his chest and sat at the table next to him. He interrupted helplessly, "I admire your attitude. Science is about continuous improvement. You must always have the ambition to master the core technology … But this is a patient, not for you to do research on. Besides, I don't think you can beat this redhead."

Yi Yeqing pursed her lips and turned around to pack up the diagnostic equipment. She casually said, "She doesn't need to see a doctor at all. Her superpower has been suppressed for too long and can't be used effectively. As long as she doesn't die, her superpower will gradually recover and let her return to normal. Even … Forget it. Anyway, she just needs to rest for a while and her body will recover and the scars will disappear."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. He could tell that Yi Yeqing was implying something, so he started to plan.

In his previous life, Aurora had been reduced to a pulp, so he didn't have the opportunity to see the exact effects of her superpower. He also didn't know what it would be like when it matured.

Since she's Hella's sister, Aurora shouldn't be too bad. Maybe she can control life? Han Xiao started to make wild guesses.

If he wanted to know Aurora's condition, he would have to use battle information. At the very least, he would have to slap this poor little girl. With his strength, the result would not be good … Han Xiao naturally wouldn't do that, and Hella would definitely fight him to the death.

Hella breathed a sigh of relief. She stood behind Aurora and pressed her hands on her shoulders, gently squeezing them.

It was good that her sister was fine.

"Right, she was brainwashed before and gave birth to another personality. She will be triggered by keywords and become a puppet that will only listen to orders. Do you have a solution?" Han Xiao repeated what Cyberlos said.

"I'm a pharmacist, not a psychiatrist. You should find a professional." Yi Yeqing didn't even turn around. "But from my experience, if it's a normal brainwashing method, if it's not triggered and deepened for a long time, the Thought Seal will gradually fade over time until it disappears. That's why the guards on Bell of Death Island brainwash the prisoners every once in a while. But as you know, the people there are very strong, and brainwashing is not very effective. Instead, every time this happens, there will always be prisoners who will kill a few guards to relieve their boredom."

Professional? Han Xiao touched his chin and pondered. Suddenly, he looked at Hella. Isn't the mind Hella's strength?

Noticing his gaze, Hella waved her hand and frowned. "My superpower is too invasive. I'm afraid of making a mistake, so I can't take the risk."

"Then you better develop your superpower more." Han Xiao was helpless. In his impression, Hella at her peak could easily flatten the soul of a living being into all kinds of shapes without damaging the fragile soul. It was like blowing candy.

"If there's nothing else, let's go. I still have a few Inhumans to test the potion. Don't disturb me."

The few of them turned to look. Emerald Grass took out a transparent container filled with a strange liquid. It was a viscous green color and was still bubbling. She held a syringe and flicked the tip of the needle with her fingernail.

Oh, I forgot to mention. In the technological civilization, Yi Yeqing was called a pharmacist.

In the magic civilization, pharmacists were called witches …

Han Xiao silently observed three seconds of silence for the players who had tested the potion.

Sacrificing for the advancement of science, how noble.

After leaving the potion lab, the few of them slowly walked on the road. Hella suddenly turned around and asked seriously, "What do you think?"

Only when it came to Aurora did Hella seem to be very concerned. She was no longer expressionless and cold. Because she trusted Han Xiao, she asked for his opinion. As the saying goes, half of the military medal is yours and half of the medal is mine. Han Xiao descended from the heavens and saved Aurora from the sea of suffering. Now, they had no relatives in the world. Only Han Xiao could be trusted.

Han Xiao pinched his chin and said, "It's best for her to rest. I'll make a special wheelchair for her. Also, your sister has been locked up for so long. It's best to let her get in touch with the outside world and make some new friends. If you don't trust me, I can introduce a few good law-abiding teenagers."

Hella nodded solemnly. "I owe you."

"You owe me in the first place." Han Xiao picked his ear.

Hella was at a loss for words. She shook her head and remembered the favor in her heart.

She had a cold personality. In fact, she was a cold-blooded and proud person. She did not like to accept the kindness of others and was unwilling to accept help that was like charity. However, once she owed a favor, she would remember it in her heart. She was a person of action. She would not say too many words of gratitude. She would only secretly remember the kindness of helping others in their hour of need and wait for the day to return the favor to Han Xiao.

After a moment of silence, Hella asked the question that had always been on her mind. "Why did you save my sister?"

"Foresight." Han Xiao used this all-purpose reason.

"Then what did you foresee?" Hella frowned.

Han Xiao laughed and made up a story. "I saw your sister's ability. It will save my life in the future. Do you believe me?"

"That makes sense." Hella suddenly understood.

At this time, a small hand tugged at the corner of Han Xiao's clothes. He looked down and saw Aurora looking up at him with a serious face.

"Uncle Zero, I will definitely save you."

Aurora took his words seriously.

Han Xiao pinched her face and laughed. "Zero is in the past tense. Just call me Han Xiao."

"Okay, Uncle Han."

"You can call me younger …"

"Got it, Uncle Han."

Han Xiao rolled his dead fish eyes.

'Sure enough, I still hate little kids!'

…

The next day, Han Xiao rushed to make a wheelchair and gave it to Aurora.

"Leather armrests and cushions, lined with elastic cotton. It will give you the comfort of your mother's embrace. And the most amazing thing is …" Han Xiao lifted the dust-proof cloth and said, "This wheelchair is driven by pedals. It has a built-in small engine, and there is a gearshift lever beside the armrest. It can go up to 40 kilometers per hour!"

"I only want an ordinary wheelchair …" Hella's eyes twitched.

She had never heard of a wheelchair that was driven by pedals. So what was the wheelchair used for?

Forty kilometers per hour? Are you planning to hold a wheelchair rally race?! ' Are you crazy!?

"If I don't modify it, what kind of mechanic am I?" Han Xiao picked his nose and looked at her from the corner of his eyes. Hella felt the disdain of a professional from his eyes.

Aurora liked the wheelchair very much, as if she had gotten a new toy. At this time, Mad Blade and the others walked over from afar. Han Xiao called them over to play with Aurora and gave them a bunch of missions.

He was worried that there was no suitable mission to train them. It was not like they could all sing and dance like Mad Blade. Playing with a little girl was much more reliable than singing and dancing.

The four players were also very curious about the missions. The rewards were unbelievably generous. They thought that this was some kind of hidden mission and had a lot of fun doing it. Aurora and Aurora got along the best. After a few words, the bear cub changed hands. It lay on Aurora's lap and rolled around on its belly, making Aurora giggle.

The scene was full of warmth, as if the sun had coated it in a warm yellow color.

Hella's eyes softened. She stepped aside and watched her sister play with her new friends.

…

For the next few days, Aurora's smile became brighter and brighter, and her complexion improved at a visible rate.

After settling Hella and her sister, the expedition war was getting better and better. The arena in the sanctuary was built during this time, so Han Xiao's attention immediately turned to business.

He had two priorities. One was to prepare for leaving the planet and accumulate all kinds of resources.

The second was to improve the player's main city and deepen his position in the hearts of the players, indirectly increasing his influence. He also planned for the Pro League, which was a huge business opportunity in his eyes.

The similarity between the two was that he wanted to squeeze benefits out of the players.

"Heh heh heh …" A creepy laughter echoed in the sealed room.
